description: This file defines a class 'History' that manages undo/redo/revert history for the MenuLibre application, including signal emission for state changes.

classes.name: History
classes.description: A class that manages undo/redo history stacks, emits signals on state changes, and supports blocking/unblocking updates.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the History object, setting up undo/redo stacks and internal state.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new change to the history and clears redo stack.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores an original value for potential revert.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Returns a copy of the restore dictionary.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Performs an undo operation, returning the key and previous value.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Performs a redo operation, returning the key and new value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all history and restore data.

methods.name: is_blocked
methods.description: Checks if history updates are currently blocked.

methods.name: _append_undo
methods.description: Internal method to add an undo entry and emit signal if needed.

methods.name: _pop_undo
methods.description: Internal method to pop an undo entry and emit signal if needed.

methods.name: _clear_undo
methods.description: Internal method to clear undo stack and emit signal if needed.

methods.name: _clear_redo
methods.description: Internal method to clear redo stack and emit signal if needed.

methods.name: _append_redo
methods.description: Internal method to add a redo entry and emit signal if needed.

methods.name: _pop_redo
methods.description: Internal method to pop a redo entry and emit signal if needed.

methods.name: _check_revert
methods.description: Checks whether to emit 'revert-changed' signal based on undo/redo stacks.
